_comment: Node catalogue for claude-proxy (v2.1+). Clients fetch this with 'proxy-nodes --refresh'.
ORDER MATTERS: a node's position gives it its side-tunnel SOCKS port (NODE_SOCKS_BASE + index),
so append new nodes at the END and never reorder - reordering changes ports on every client.
'host' may be an IP or a DNS name (a DNS name lets you re-IP a VM without touching clients).
A 'host' left as <...> means 'not provisioned yet' - clients list the node but don't create an alias.
'hostkey' (optional) is the VM's public host key, e.g. from:  ssh-keyscan -t ed25519 <host> | cut -d' ' -f2-
When set, clients add it to known_hosts so the first connection never asks 'Are you sure...?'.
Keep ONE node per line - the shell profile has a jq-less fallback parser that relies on it.
'user': leave EMPTY when every person has their own account (sshu-manager) - clients then reuse the User
of their existing jpvpn alias. Set it only if all users share one login on that node.
